parsed_json.up: Select distinct compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id) and canonical_smiles (from compound_structures). Join target_dictionary on chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2971', then assays on tid, then activities on assay_id, then molecule_dictionary on molregno, then LEFT JOIN compound_structures on molregno. Filter where assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Sort by compound_chembl_id then canonical_smiles.
